description: Client-side script for handling the 'Bank Statement Import' form in Frappe/ERPNext, managing import setup, progress, validation, and logs.

classes.name: frappe.data_import.ImportPreview
classes.description: Class for rendering and managing the import preview UI component.

methods.name: show_import_preview
methods.description: Initializes and displays the import preview component with given data.

methods.name: show_import_warnings
methods.description: Displays warnings related to import data, grouped by row or column.

methods.name: export_errored_rows
methods.description: Triggers download of errored import rows as a template.

methods.name: show_import_log
methods.description: Displays the import log with success/failure messages and traceback details.

methods.name: show_failed_logs
methods.description: Triggers display of import logs with errors.

methods.name: show_report_error_button
methods.description: Adds a button to report the latest error if the import status is 'Error'.

methods.name: start_import
methods.description: Initiates the import process for the current data import.

methods.name: download_template
methods.description: Downloads a template for bank transaction import.

methods.name: reference_doctype
methods.description: Handles changes to the reference doctype field.

methods.name: toggle_submit_after_import
methods.description: Shows or hides the submit after import option based on doctype properties.

methods.name: google_sheets_url
methods.description: Handles updates to the Google Sheets URL field.

methods.name: refresh_google_sheet
methods.description: Refreshes the import preview when Google Sheets URL is updated.

methods.name: import_file
methods.description: Loads and previews the import file or Google Sheets data.
